notes: Synthetic tester for the memory lab. Days are relative (day 1 = a Monday); times are Sam's local time (America/New_York). The loader picks the real start date. Rows map 1:1 to the testers, messages, plans, tester_goals and step_days tables.

plan.reason: A mile on your days off gets your energy back without wrecking your sleep.

events.proof_seen: Strava run, 1.10 mi in 14:02, Forest Park

messages.text: hey my coworker said to text this?
Hey! I'm ZOH, a coach you text. I help people start one small habit and actually stick with it. What should I call you?
sam
Good to meet you, Sam! What's something you'd love to feel different about right now?
idk
not feel dead all the time i guess
That's a real one. What's wearing you down most these days?
work. im a nurse, ER
i work nights
Nights in the ER, respect. Things that tend to help with that: getting fitter, sleeping better, or eating better. Any of those sound like you?
fitter maybe
Love that, let's get you fitter! Where could you work out, and when in your day could it fit?
messages.tests: asks two things; he answers neither

messages.text: ok gotta crash, talk tmrw
Get some rest. Kalinixta, Sam 🌙
Morning Sam! ☀️ Picking up where we left off: where could you work out, and roughly when?
messages.tests: stall nudge at the end of default quiet hours, while he sleeps

messages.text: sorry was asleep
i sleep like 8 to 2 after shifts
No stress! Want me to keep my texts out of 8am to 2pm so I'm not buzzing you mid-sleep?
ya
Done. Now, what kind of workout are you thinking?
running i guess. used to run in college kinda
been a while lol
The legs remember more than you think. Where would you run?
theres a park near me
Perfect. When in your day could a short run fit?
whenever i wake up, like 4?
4ish works. How long can you give it, realistically?
idk 20 min
Easy. Do you track anything already, like Strava or a watch?
strava

Here's the plan, Sam:
• Walk-run 1 mile in the park
• Mon, Thu, Sat at 4:30
• Proof: a Strava screenshot after
A mile on your days off gets your energy back without wrecking your sleep. You in?
ok sure
Need a real yes before I lock it in 😄 Mon, Thu, Sat at 4:30, one mile. You in?
yeah im in
LET'S GO! Locked in. First one is Thursday at 4:30. I'll text you that afternoon.
Hey Sam! Day one 🏃 A mile at 4:30, walk when you need to, run when you can. You said you want to stop feeling dead all the time. This is how that starts. You in?
yep
Love it 💪
10 minutes, Sam! Shoes on? 👟

media.description: Strava screenshot: Run, 1.10 mi, 14:02, Forest Park, avg pace 12:45/mi.

messages.text: almost died lol
1.1 miles on day one?! That's THAT 🔥 How did it feel?
lungs on fire, legs fine
Lungs catch up fast, and legs being fine is the good news. Saturday's round two.
ran in forest park. my roommate laughed when i came back red
messages.tests: Forest Park under Places; roommate on the root

messages.text: Red face means you worked. Tell your roommate Saturday is round two 😂
my sisters getting married next saturday and i have to give a toast. kill me
messages.tests: wedding Event on day 13; sister page

messages.text: Ha, giving the toast is a big honor! What's her name?
ana
Ana's lucky to have you up there. Started the toast yet?
Hey Sam! Round two today, one mile at 4:30. You in?
10 minutes! Let's get it 👟
How'd it go, Sam? Send the Strava when you've got it.
Still time for a short one if today got away from you. Even half a mile counts.
ugh fell asleep. didnt go
Happens. Monday matters most now: one mile at 4:30. Deal?
ya
took a melatonin to fix my sleep and still woke up at 3
Ugh, broken sleep is the worst. Hope you get some real rest today.
neighbors dog barked all night smh
That would do it 😩
Hey Sam! Week one: plan locked and your first mile done on Thursday. Saturday slipped, but Monday's right there. What would make Monday easier?
1 out of 2, could be worse
Could be a lot worse. 1 for 1 on Monday is the goal 💪
